<edit path="tests/test_rotate_logs.py">
import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

SCRIPT = Path(
    os.environ.get(
        "ROTATE_LOGS_SCRIPT",
        Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "bin" / "rotate-logs.sh",
    )
)


def test_keeps_the_seven_newest_gz_archives(tmp_path):
    names = [f"harbor-{i:02d}.log.gz" for i in range(10)]
    for i, name in enumerate(names):
        f = tmp_path / name
        f.write_text("x")
        mtime = 1_700_000_000 + i * 60  # higher i = newer
        os.utime(f, (mtime, mtime))

    subprocess.run(["sh", str(SCRIPT), str(tmp_path)], check=True)

    remaining = sorted(p.name for p in tmp_path.glob("*.gz"))
    assert remaining == names[3:]  # the seven newest survive, the three oldest are gone
</edit>
